description: This PHP class, 'Rels', is part of the PHPSpreadsheet library, specifically responsible for generating XML relationship files (.rels) for XLSX workbooks, worksheets, and related parts. It handles writing relationships for various components such as core properties, styles, themes, sheets, drawings, charts, hyperlinks, comments, and VBA projects within the context of XLSX file creation.

classes.name: Rels
classes.description: Handles writing XML relationship files (.rels) for various parts of an XLSX spreadsheet, including workbooks, worksheets, drawings, charts, and related external resources within the PHPSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: writeRelationships
methods.description: Generates the relationships XML content for the entire spreadsheet package, including core, extended, custom properties, and workbook relationships.

methods.name: writeWorkbookRelationships
methods.description: Creates the relationships XML for the workbook component, linking styles, theme, shared strings, sheets, and macros if present.

methods.name: writeWorksheetRelationships
methods.description: Produces relationships XML for a specific worksheet, including drawings, hyperlinks, comments, tables, headers/footers, and unparsed relationships.

methods.name: writeDrawingRelationships
methods.description: Generates relationships XML for drawing elements, including images and charts within a worksheet.

methods.name: writeHeaderFooterDrawingRelationships
methods.description: Creates relationships XML for header and footer images, typically used for background images or other visuals in headers/footers.

methods.name: writeVMLDrawingRelationships
methods.description: Produces relationships XML for VML (Vector Markup Language) drawings, especially background images in comments or headers/footers.

methods.name: writeRelationship
methods.description: Helper method to write a single relationship element with the provided ID, type, target, and optional target mode.

methods.name: writeDrawingHyperLink
methods.description: Helper method to write hyperlink relationship for a drawing if it has an associated hyperlink.

methods.name: writeUnparsedRelationship
methods.description: Handles writing relationships for unparsed loaded data, such as custom or extension relationships.
